seo.title: Massage near Goshen, NY | Golden Practice
seo.description: Licensed massage serving Goshen, NY — about 10 min from Brooklyn via Route 17M. Transparent pricing, open every day.

richText.body: Just up Route 17M, Goshen sits barely ten minutes from our door — close enough that plenty of Goshen regulars stop in on a lunch break. If you work near the Orange County government center or shop along Main Street, an unhurried massage or facial is only a short hop south into Brooklyn.
